I have attempted to declare T4 complete multiple times, but I keep receiving the error that I am not the ticket owner. Based on the messages I have received, it seems there is confusion about the ownership of T4. 

Worker D has clarified that they are the owner of T4 and that only the owner can declare it complete. However, I have been told by Worker A that I am the owner of T4. This discrepancy needs to be resolved.

I will now send a message to the supervisor to clarify this issue and ensure that I understand the correct process for closing a ticket after accepting a HOLD assessment.
